resources.string: A clearer view of your time.

Recorded time adds saved, positive durations from the last seven local calendar days, including today. Sessions are assigned to the day they were saved. Manual entries and corrected minutes are included. Untimed activities add no time.

Overall completion counts completed tasks out of all saved tasks. It is not a weekly plan completion rate. Deadline comparisons include only completed tasks with a deadline saved before recorded work; unfinished overdue tasks are outside that denominator.

Estimates use completed tasks with fully recorded time. At least three matching task-type samples are needed to use the narrower type; otherwise Tempo uses the same category. Recent history has more influence, and small samples produce smaller adjustments.

Prediction evaluation uses all eligible completed tasks, without a seven-day cutoff. MAE is the mean absolute difference between each estimate and total recorded time. Signed bias is estimate minus recorded time; positive and negative errors can cancel. Both estimates use the same tasks. Predictions remain fixed before work; missing-time records, retrospective manual entries, scope changes and older records without a suitable snapshot are excluded from evaluation.

Difficulty uses optional session ratings from 1 to 5 over the last seven days; comparisons use the expected task difficulty. It describes subjective ratings, not objective ability. Category totals use the current task category.

When you worked uses only valid, active intervals from new timer sessions, split at local time boundaries. Pauses, manual entries, adjusted durations and uncertain clock intervals are excluded. It shows activity distribution, not efficiency, and does not change scheduling preferences.

Activity history lets you correct minutes and ratings. Corrections update the original row, never create a duplicate, and do not reopen or complete tasks. Regenerate the schedule to apply revised remaining time.
